avoid_supplements.name: Calcium Carbonate
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Omeprazole reduces gastric acid, impairing calcium carbonate absorption; separate administration by 2+ hours
avoid_supplements.action: Use calcium citrate instead or take calcium supplement 2 hours after omeprazole dose

avoid_supplements.name: Iron Supplements
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Reduced gastric acidity decreases non-heme iron absorption by 50-65%
avoid_supplements.action: Separate iron and omeprazole by at least 2 hours; consider iron supplementation timing or form adjustment

avoid_supplements.name: Magnesium Supplements
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Chronic PPI use reduces magnesium absorption and increases hypomagnesemia risk with long-term supplementation
avoid_supplements.action: Monitor magnesium levels with chronic use; space dosing 2+ hours apart

caution_supplements.name: Vitamin B12 Supplements
caution_supplements.mechanism: Omeprazole reduces B12 absorption from food sources; supplementation may be needed with chronic therapy (>1 year)
caution_supplements.action: Monitor B12 levels annually; consider supplementation if deficiency develops

caution_supplements.name: Cyanocobalamin/Methylcobalamin
caution_supplements.mechanism: Reduced intrinsic factor and gastric acid reduce food-bound B12 absorption, but synthetic forms bypass this mechanism
caution_supplements.action: Use methylcobalamin or cyanocobalamin supplements if B12 deficiency occurs

avoid_foods.name: Iron-Rich Foods (spinach, red meat, fortified cereals)
avoid_foods.mechanism: Omeprazole-induced hypochlorhydria impairs non-heme iron absorption from food sources
avoid_foods.action: Consume iron-rich foods 2+ hours apart from omeprazole; ensure adequate dietary iron intake or supplement with separated dosing

caution_foods.name: Calcium-Rich Foods (dairy, fortified products)
caution_foods.mechanism: Reduced acid may modestly decrease calcium absorption from food; effect is less significant than with supplements
caution_foods.action: Maintain adequate dietary calcium intake; no specific separation required for food sources

caution_foods.name: High-Fat Meals
caution_foods.mechanism: May delay omeprazole absorption and peak levels; minimal clinical impact on efficacy
caution_foods.action: Take omeprazole on empty stomach (30-60 minutes before food) for optimal absorption

monitoring_notes: Monitor for hypomagnesemia, B12 deficiency, and iron deficiency with chronic omeprazole use (>1 year). Assess baseline magnesium and B12 levels before long-term therapy; recheck annually if supplementation or dietary sources are inadequate.
